lines.text: The Philistine lords gathered to offer a great sacrifice to their god Dagon and praised him for delivering Samson.
The Philistines called Samson out of the prison to entertain them and stationed him between the pillars of the temple.
Samson called out to the LORD and asked to be strengthened just once more to pay back the Philistines for his two eyes.
Samson braced his right hand on one central pillar and his left on the other, and the temple fell on the lords.
Samson's brothers and his father's family carried him back and buried him in the tomb of his father Manoah.
